name: Civil Air Patrol Cadets, Northeast Philadelphia Composite Squadron
org: Civil Air Patrol, Northeast Philadelphia Composite Squadron (PA-214)
what_you_do: Go to weekly squadron meetings of the Civil Air Patrol. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
who_can_apply: Cadets ages 12 to 18. The Pennsylvania Wing page lists Become a Cadet as ages 12 to 18.
pay_detail: Civil Air Patrol says annual dues are $25 to $50 depending on location, and a fully active cadet may spend $300 to $600 in the first year (minus financial help). The squadron page does not state its own dues.
duration: The squadron meets Fridays from 7:00 to 9:15 p.m. at the Naval Support Activity Center, 700 Robbins St, Philadelphia, PA 19111.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron any time.
how_to_apply: The squadron page does not describe a visit process. Contact the squadron: cc214@pawg.cap.gov (squadron commander) or 215-531-2278. The wing's Join CAP page has the cadet steps.
notes: The Pennsylvania Wing lists five other squadrons in the Philadelphia area. They are Willow Grove, Liberty, Griffin, Gen Carl A Spaatz and Chester County. Ask the wing which is closest to you. The dues range and first-year cost come from the national Civil Air Patrol cadet page.
